segments.name: Human therapeutics
segments.description: Discovers, develops, manufactures and delivers innovative medicines to fight serious diseases for patients worldwide.
segments.evidence: Amgen operates in one operating segment: human therapeutics.

revenueModel.text: Amgen sells its medicines principally to pharmaceutical wholesale distributors in the U.S. and to healthcare providers and/or distributors abroad.
revenueModel.evidence: In the United States, substantially all of our sales are to pharmaceutical wholesale distributors, which is the principal means of distributing our products to healthcare providers.
